title: UL-09 — Challenge: Auto Scaling
scenario: Use target tracking scaling to reach two instances briefly, then scale to zero and delete.
acceptanceCriteria: Launch template defines instance type and tags LabId=ul-09.
Auto Scaling group uses target tracking policy on average CPU (target 50%).
Policy drives desired capacity up toward 2 instances under load or alarm simulation.
You scale desired capacity back to 0 manually after observation.
Auto Scaling group deleted with force-delete.
Cost-risk phrase logged before instances launch.
No orphaned EBS volumes from lab instances.
CloudWatch alarm tied to policy is deleted if created.
Teardown removes security groups dedicated to lab.
stopChargesPanel: Scale the ASG to 0, force-delete it and wait for its instances to terminate, then delete the CloudWatch alarm (if you created one), the launch template and the lab SG for ul-09.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: # Uses: $AsgName, $LaunchTemplateId, $AlarmName, $SgId (the IDs you set while building; unset ones are skipped)
# Lost an ID? aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-09

if ($AsgName) { aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name $AsgName --min-size 0 --max-size 0 --desired-capacity 0; aws autoscaling delete-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name $AsgName --force-delete }

if ($AsgName) { $i = 0; do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 15; $AsgLeft = aws autoscaling describe-auto-scaling-groups --auto-scaling-group-names $AsgName --query "length(AutoScalingGroups)" --output text; $i++ } while ($AsgLeft -and $AsgLeft -ne '0' -and $i -lt 60); if ($i -ge 60) { Write-Host 'Timed out waiting for the ASG to delete after 60 tries; check the Auto Scaling console before deleting the launch template' } }
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-09 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws autoscaling describe-auto-scaling-groups --auto-scaling-group-names $AsgName returns an empty AutoScalingGroups list
aws ec2 describe-volumes --filters Name=tag:LabId,Values=ul-09 returns an empty Volumes list
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-09 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-09. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-09) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.
